reviewed.packages/web/adwaita-web: Adwaita Sans: A PROGRESSIVE ENHANCEMENT over a system-installed face, not an omission. The typeface does ship — `@gjsify/adwaita-fonts` vendors both Sans TTFs — but the only form that survives a `--app browser` build is a `data:` URI (the target emits one file and no assets, so a relative `url()` 404s), and inlining the two faces costs 2.39 MB / 1.18 MB gzip against this package's 190 KB / 26 KB stylesheet. `--app browser` also has no code splitting (`output.inlineDynamicImports`), so a lazy face would cost the same bytes as an eager one: the choice really is all-or-nothing. So the root entry names the family and the app decides, with `applyAdwaitaFonts()` from `@gjsify/adwaita-web/fonts` — one VALUE import, which is the shape that cannot be silently discarded. What made this an accident rather than a decision until now was `import '@gjsify/adwaita-fonts';` in `src/index.ts`: under css-as-string that resolves to `export default "<css>"`, tree-shakes to a MEASURED 0-byte bundle and exits 0. Revisit when the fonts package ships subsetted woff2 (status/open-todos.md) — at fontsource-like sizes the default flips.
reviewed.packages/web/adwaita-web: Adwaita Mono: Nothing in this workspace ships a mono face at all: `@gjsify/adwaita-fonts` vendors two Sans TTFs, and the upstream `refs/adwaita-fonts/mono/` faces are 1.4-1.5 MB EACH, so committing them is a licensing and size decision that belongs to a human, not to a fix. `--monospace-font-family` therefore heads with 'Adwaita Mono' for the GNOME desktops that have `adwaita-mono-fonts` installed, and falls through `ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Menlo', monospace` everywhere else — which is what the generic tail is for. The reason this entry exists is that the SCSS used to assert the opposite in prose ('Adwaita Mono heads it because @gjsify/adwaita-fonts ships it') while the NativeScript theme carrying the same stack already said the truth. The token's consumers are `.monospace` (_labels.scss), `_action_row.scss`, the data-grid mono cell and `<adw-source-view>` — the last of which read a SECOND, longer stack from a TS literal (`source-view/theme.ts`) until it was pointed at this token, so an editor and a `.monospace` label on one page rendered in different typefaces, and the literal was outside this rule, which reads `.css`/`.scss` only.
reviewed.packages/nativescript-bridge/adwaita: Ad: Same absent face as adwaita-web's entry, reached from `.adw-data-grid-cell.mono` in `src/theme/adwaita.css`. It is the more honest of the two copies: its comment already said `@gjsify/adwaita-fonts` ships no mono TTF. NativeScript does not load `@font-face` at all — a TTF has to be copied into `App_Resources` and matched by file name (Android) or PostScript name (iOS), which `src/fonts.ts` documents — so even a vendored mono face would not make this stack resolve without an app-side install step.
